SELECT i.ITEM_ID, i.HEAD_ID, i.INSTITUTION_ID, i.FIELD_CD, i.STATE_CD, i.ORIGIN_CD, i.VAL_TEXT, i.VAL_DATE, i.VAL_FLAG, i.SRC_KIND_CD, i.SRC_TITLE, i.CHECKED_ON, i.CREATED_BY, i.DECIDED_BY, h.STATUS_CD AS HEAD_STATUS FROM INST_HEAD_ITEM i JOIN INST_HEAD h ON h.HEAD_ID = i.HEAD_ID WHERE h.STATUS_CD = 'CURRENT' AND i.STATE_CD = 'CONFIRMED' AND i.FIELD_CD IN ('NAME', 'POSITION', 'ACTING', 'FIRST_TAKE_OFFICE', 'TERM_START', 'TERM_END')

SELECT i.ITEM_ID, i.HEAD_ID, i.INSTITUTION_ID, i.FIELD_CD, i.STATE_CD, i.ORIGIN_CD, i.VAL_TEXT, i.VAL_DATE, i.VAL_FLAG, i.SRC_KIND_CD, i.SRC_TITLE, i.CHECKED_ON, i.CREATED_BY, i.DECIDED_BY, h.STATUS_CD AS HEAD_STATUS FROM INST_HEAD_ITEM i JOIN INST_HEAD h ON h.HEAD_ID = i.HEAD_ID WHERE i.STATE_CD = 'CANDIDATE' AND i.INSTITUTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND h.STATUS_CD IN ('CURRENT', 'CANDIDATE')

SELECT i.INSTITUTION_ID AS INSTITUTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS N FROM INST_HEAD_ITEM i JOIN INST_HEAD h ON h.HEAD_ID = i.HEAD_ID WHERE i.STATE_CD = 'CANDIDATE' AND i.INSTITUTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND h.STATUS_CD IN ('CURRENT', 'CANDIDATE') GROUP BY i.INSTITUTION_ID
SELECT p.HEAD_ID FROM INST_HEAD_PHOTO p JOIN INST_HEAD h ON h.HEAD_ID = p.HEAD_ID WHERE p.STATE_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND h.STATUS_CD = 'CURRENT'

SELECT h.HEAD_ID AS HEAD_ID, (SELECT MAX(i.VAL_TEXT) FROM INST_HEAD_ITEM i WHERE i.HEAD_ID = h.HEAD_ID AND i.FIELD_CD = 'NAME' AND i.STATE_CD = 'CANDIDATE') AS NAME_VAL, (SELECT MAX(i.VAL_TEXT) FROM INST_HEAD_ITEM i WHERE i.HEAD_ID = h.HEAD_ID AND i.FIELD_CD = 'POSITION' AND i.STATE_CD = 'CANDIDATE') AS POSITION_VAL, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INST_HEAD_ITEM i WHERE i.HEAD_ID = h.HEAD_ID AND i.STATE_CD = 'CANDIDATE') AS N FROM INST_HEAD h WHERE h.INSTITUTION_ID IS NULL AND h.STATUS_CD = 'CANDIDATE' ORDER BY h.HEAD_ID

SELECT l.LOG_ID AS LOG_ID, l.EVENT_CD AS EVENT_CD, l.INSTITUTION_ID AS INSTITUTION_ID, l.HEAD_ID AS HEAD_ID, l.PHOTO_ID AS PHOTO_ID, l.FROM_PHOTO_ID AS FROM_PHOTO_ID, l.ACTOR_EMP_NO AS ACTOR_EMP_NO, l.ACTOR_ROLE AS ACTOR_ROLE, l.SELF_FLAG AS SELF_FLAG, l.LOGGED_AT AS LOGGED_AT, (SELECT MAX(i.VAL_TEXT) FROM INST_HEAD_ITEM i WHERE i.HEAD_ID = l.HEAD_ID AND i.FIELD_CD = 'NAME' AND i.STATE_CD = 'CONFIRMED') AS NAME_VAL FROM INST_HEAD_LOG l WHERE l.EVENT_CD IN ('PHOTO_ADD', 'PHOTO_REPLACE', 'PHOTO_VOID', 'PHOTO_RESTORE') AND l.LOGGED_AT >= #{since} ORDER BY l.LOG_ID DESC
